Subject: Private plan on Azure – SOW & SKU attribution questions

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the call earlier. We want to move forward with the Private Plan on Azure but have two open items before procurement can issue the PO: 1) the SOW needs a minor billing routing change so invoices go to our AP system (see attached Billing_Routing_Instructions.docx), and 2) we need confirmation on how the Private SKU will appear in Azure reporting so our reseller/co-sell attribution with Microsoft is preserved.

Can you confirm whether the SKU on the Azure private offer will be the same as the Marketplace SKU in the attached export, and whether the invoice will come from Redwood or via a reseller? Our legal team also asked for a short redline of the SOW to reflect the billing destination.

If possible, can we get a revised SOW and a one-page note on invoice flow by EOD Thursday 10/29? We want to get procurement approval that same week.

Appreciate it — Olivia

--
Olivia Turner

Subject: Re: Private plan on Azure – SOW & SKU attribution questions

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the clear asks.

Short answers up front: 1) We can route invoices directly to ProcureHealth AP (Bill-to) and will update the SOW to reflect the billing contact and PO requirements. 2) For the Azure private offer, the SKU visible to you in reporting will match the Marketplace SKU we register, and reseller attribution (co-sell) will remain intact — but there are a couple of edge cases (reseller-led vs. direct-bill) that we should confirm with Microsoft for your account.

I'll loop in Finance and Marketplace ops to get the SOW redline and an invoice-flow diagram. Expect a draft SOW v1.2 and a one-page invoice flow note by Thursday EOD. If procurement needs DocuSign for signatures, we can produce that too.

I'll also include a short note on how entitlements map to the SKU and whether any metering artifacts change when we enable the Private Plan.

—Sean

Sean Gallagher

Sean / Marissa — added Lauren from legal for a quick redline. Finance (cc'd) confirms we can bill ProcureHealth directly; two notes: 1) for Azure private offers the Marketplace reports SKU-level usage to Microsoft and that is what their co-sell reporting will consume. We need to ensure the SKU we publish is the one on their procurement export. 2) If ProcureHealth requires reseller-originated invoices (for partner margin reasons), we would need a reseller agreement — confirm now if that is the case.

Action items I will take:
- Produce SOW v1.2 with billing contact and PO clause updated (attach redline)
- Generate a one-page Invoice Flow (who receives invoice, payer name, remittance address, tax info)
- Confirm Marketplace SKU mapping and provide guidance on attribution caveats

I should have the documents by Thursday afternoon.

Rishi
Finance — Redwood Inference

I kept the language tight.

Marissa — please double-check the billing address and tax ID fields in the Billing_Routing_Instructions.docx before we send externally.

Redwood will be the invoicing entity for this agreement unless ProcureHealth requests reseller invoicing; please confirm if reseller billing is required."

Subject: Final SOW & invoice flow for Azure Private Plan (attached / next steps)

Hi Olivia — attaching the redlined SOW (ProcureHealth_SOW_v1.2.pdf) and a short invoice flow doc. Highlights:
- Invoices will be issued by Redwood Inference (Bill-to: ProcureHealth); remittance and tax info included.
- The Private Plan SKU will match the Marketplace SKU we publish; Azure reporting will show usage at the SKU level and that will be what Microsoft consumes for co-sell attribution.
- If ProcureHealth requires reseller-originated invoices, we will need to execute a reseller agreement and update the order form accordingly — please confirm now if that is required to avoid delays.

Next steps:
1) ProcureHealth confirms billing instructions and whether reseller billing is required.
2) Once confirmed, we will prepare a DocuSign envelope with the final SOW + Order Form and send for signature.
3) We will also coordinate with Microsoft (Michael) to validate SKU mapping if you want us to involve them directly.

DocuSign (draft) link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/0a1b2c3d-ProcureHealth

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week.
